description: Golden evaluation cases for RE Financial Services Monthly Trend Analysis Skill

cases.name: Normal Complete Financial Data
cases.description: Standard 12-month complete financial statements in chronological order with zero anomalies.

cases.name: Reversed Month Ordering
cases.description: Financial statements stored in reverse chronological order (newest month to oldest). Engine must detect and restore chronological ordering.

cases.name: December 2025 Accounting Anomaly
cases.description: Significant non-recurring tax benefit credit ($1M+) in operating expenses and unusual stock-based compensation spike. Engine must flag both entries and reject genuine profitability.

cases.name: 11 Months vs 12 Months TTM Eligibility
cases.description: Dataset containing exactly 11 consecutive months. TTM rolling window must NOT be calculated, and limitation flag must be emitted.

cases.name: Negative Line-Item Reversals
cases.description: Contains negative line item revenue and expense reversals. MoM % must divide by absolute value of prior month, and reversals must be flagged.

cases.name: Missing Calendar Month Gap
cases.description: Financial dataset missing March 2025. Engine must detect missing month gap, flag it as CRITICAL, and suppress TTM windows spanning across the gap.

cases.name: Inconsistent Totals & Discrepancies
cases.description: Worksheet where reported total operating expenses diverges from component sums. Engine must catch reconciliation discrepancy and flag CRITICAL error.

cases.name: Different Company & Generalization
cases.description: Statements from Test Corp with entirely different chart of accounts. Engine must parse, calculate, and report without any hardcoded modifications.

cases.name: Generalized Subtotals & Multi-Department Hierarchy
cases.description: Financial statements from Apex Dynamics with non-standard department subtotal names (Total Sales Salaries, Total Growth & Advertising). Engine must properly recognize subtotals and avoid double counting.
